sloka: क्षिप्रमद्यैव दुर्धर्षाम् पुरीम् रावणपालिताम् ।अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वैर्हरिभिरावृताः ॥६-२३-१३॥।।
transliteration: kṣipramadyaiva durdharṣām purīm rāvaṇapālitām ।abhiyāma javenaiva sarvairharibhirāvṛtāḥ ॥6-23-13॥।।

translations.english: All the Vanaras turning their direction will go immediately and now itself, swiftly to the city ruled by Ravana (said Rama to Lakshmana).
